items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: In interviews with Goodman and Sullivan and Tough and all those guys, they said, “Well my influence was —” and almost in every case it was New Orleans musicians.

ctx.x: Do you recall seeing — I think it’s the Glenn Miller movie, and Ben Pollack is in it?
Sure is, and the Benny Goodman Story too.
